# Button prompt packs

Xbox and Nintendo Switch Pro button prompts for Gravity Rush 2 (1.11) and Gravity Rush
Remastered (1.00) in GR2fork. A pack replaces button icons, tutorial pictures, controller
diagrams, the button font and the button wording in the game's text.

Each pack holds only the new bytes, as deltas against the player's own game files. The emulator
checks every original file before it applies a pack, and the game files on disk are never
changed. The launcher copies the packs into the emulator's user folder; the Mods tab selects one
per game.
